reason: The CIF parses and explicitly contains 14 fully occupied sites (Li2Ni4O8, reduced LiNi2O4) in the stated 133.066 A^3 primitive cell; its coordinates have exact P-1 symmetry despite the P 1 declaration, and it passes distance, coordination, charge-balance, and bond-valence checks. Indexing is strong (53 isolated components fitted to about 0.0024 degrees 2theta), and tested inverse-spinel orderings fit much worse. However, the atomic coordinates were inherited from an ideal Fd-3m spinel and constrained to one common oxygen parameter rather than solved or refined in the actual low symmetry. Recalculation from the submitted CIF gives whole-pattern RMSE 0.553 and unweighted Rwp about 10.0%, versus flat-region noise sigma about 0.097; allowing the same indexed stick positions independent amplitudes improves to RMSE 0.206 and Rwp about 3.73%. This substantial intensity-fit gap means the exact P-1 coordinates remain insufficiently established, so a further low-symmetry coordinate solution/refinement is likely to add a materially different viable realization.
